name: Nodefusion Multi-Project Codespace
postCreateCommand: curl -fsSL https://claude.ai/install.sh | bash && dotnet dev-certs https
postStartCommand: external-git clone && external-git config && echo "$SECRETS_JSON" > /workspaces/NodefusionITOps/src/Nodefusion.NodefusionITOps/secrets.json && dotnet restore /workspaces/NodefusionITOps/src/Nodefusion.NodefusionITOps/Nodefusion.NodefusionITOps.csproj && echo "$SECRETS_JSON_AEXUM" > /workspaces/Aexum/src/Nodefusion.Aexum.WebApi/secrets.json && dotnet restore /workspaces/Aexum/src/Nodefusion.Aexum.WebApi/Nodefusion.Aexum.WebApi.csproj
